title: Take a hit
prompt: The robot's `health` starts at hp. It takes a hit of 20. Take the number `20` away from health using `-=`, then return health. take_hit(100) is 80.
hints: `-=` takes away from a variable and stores the result back in it.
`health -= 20` on the line after the var line.
solution:
func take_hit(hp):
	var health = hp
	health -= 20
	return health
